name: skillevaluator
title: skillevaluator
description: Multi-tier framework for evaluating AI agent skills: quality gates with a 0-100 score, security scanning, harness compatibility checks, semantic overlap detection, synthetic eval datasets, and live agent A/B evaluation of skill lift — with reusable CI templates.
why: Skill evaluation is a genuinely distinct, unoccupied cluster: no existing entry scores skill quality/security, detects semantic overlap between skills, or A/B-tests skill lift. Tier 1 runs keyless (no API key, GPU or Docker) and gives every skill a 0-100 quality score plus a security/PII scan — direct curation QA for a 121-skill collection — and Tier 2 overlap detection speaks to the one-skill-per-cluster rule. Honest limit: harness-check and Tier 3 live agents do NOT include Muse (agents: opencode, codex, claude-code), so with/without lift measured there is a proxy, not a measurement on Muse.
